title: One project tested across runtime versions
expected: Expand a finite requested Node matrix without copying project task definitions.
Keep test reports separated by runtime variant; runtime tests do not automatically imply distinct distributable artifacts.

cases.name: unsupported-variant
cases.change: Request a runtime outside package engines.

limitations: The matrix request is harness data. Running one native command does not verify all variants.
Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
